description: This file implements error handling and reporting functions for the gn build system, including error message formatting, location highlighting, and error object management.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: A class representing an error or warning, with methods for printing and managing error details.

methods.name: Err::Err
methods.description: Constructors for creating error objects with various context (location, range, token, parse node, value).

methods.name: Err::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying error objects.

methods.name: Err::PrintToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error message to stdout, formatted with location and message.

methods.name: Err::PrintNonfatalToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error message as a non-fatal warning.

methods.name: Err::AppendSubErr
methods.description: Adds a sub-error to the current error object.

methods.name: Err::InternalPrintToStdout
methods.description: Handles the detailed formatting and output of the error message, including location highlighting and sub-errors.
